policies.title: ROC nationals: citizenship scope and nationals without household registration
policies.summary: ROC nationals are outside the foreign-passport visa-exemption scheme. A national without household registration may enter permit-free temporarily only with a valid chip ROC passport and onward or return travel; a non-chip ROC passport requires a temporary entry permit on arrival.
conditions: BOCA says the foreign-national visa-exemption practice does not apply to ROC nationals or persons not regarded as foreigners under ROC law.

For nationals without household registration, permit-free temporary entry is limited to less than three months, a valid biometric ROC passport, a return or onward ticket, and no stated entry restriction.

A non-chip ROC passport requires a temporary entry permit at arrival. Household registration, conscription, residence certificate, prior history, purpose, and re-entry restrictions remain separate facts and cannot be inferred from code TW.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: up to 90-day visa exemption
policies.summary: The listed foreign nationalities are visa-exempt for an ordinary short stay of up to 90 days.
conditions: This is limited to the BOCA foreign-national ordinary-passport visitor programme; it does not establish emergency, temporary, refugee, stateless, residence, transit, work, diplomatic, official/service, or other special-document treatment.

Normally a passport needs six months' validity, return or onward reservations and any next-destination visa; US and Japanese passports need validity for intended stay. Admission remains subject to NIA eligibility review and TWAC before clearance unless excepted.

Only UK passports with British Citizen status qualify. BOCA restricts the Marshall Islands nationality definition, restricts Eswatini and Tuvalu passports with specified places of birth, limits North Macedonia to 2030-03-31, and excludes Honduran diplomatic and official/service passports.
Stay starts after arrival and is normally non-extendable and non-convertible. It grants no permit-required activity, religious work, residence, or transit entitlement.

policies.title: Listed ordinary passports: up to 30-day visa exemption
policies.summary: Belize, Malaysia, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Singapore, and the Dominican Republic are visa-exempt for ordinary short stays of up to 30 days.
conditions: This is for formal ordinary foreign passports, not emergency, temporary, diplomatic, official/service, refugee, residence, or other special travel documents.
Dominican Republic eligibility excludes diplomatic and official/service passports. Belize, Saint Kitts and Nevis, and Saint Lucia passports with BOCA's specified places of birth are ineligible.

The normal visa-exemption validity, onward-travel, admissibility, departure, non-conversion, purpose, and arrival-card rules apply; it grants no work, residence, transit, or qualification-required access.

policies.title: Oman ordinary passports: up to 14-day visa exemption
policies.summary: Omani nationals are visa-exempt for an ordinary short stay of up to 14 days.
conditions: Normal visa-exemption validity, onward-travel, admissibility, departure, non-conversion, purpose, and arrival-card rules apply.
BOCA separately permits an eVisa application for an Omani holder planning more than 14 days; it does not extend the visa-free stay.
No work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official/service, emergency, temporary, or special-document treatment is established.

policies.title: Thailand, Brunei, and Philippines ordinary passports: 14-day trial visa exemption
policies.summary: Thai, Bruneian, and Philippine nationals using ordinary passports are visa-exempt for ordinary short stays of up to 14 days through 2027-07-31.
conditions: The trial excludes diplomatic and official/service passports. The Brunei Certificate of Identity exception is not an ordinary-passport rule.
Proof of accommodation, host or sponsor contact information, and sufficient travel funds are required; vessel or aircraft crew and service personnel reporting for duty are ineligible.

Normal visa-exemption validity, onward-travel, admissibility, departure, non-conversion, purpose, and arrival-card rules apply; no work, residence, transit, emergency, temporary, or special-document access is established.

policies.title: Visa-exempt nationalities: emergency or temporary passports landing visa
policies.summary: Except for the United States, a national of a visa-exempt country using an emergency or temporary passport may obtain a 30-day landing visa when the stated conditions are met.
conditions: This is not an ordinary-passport arrival-visa entitlement: it is limited to emergency or temporary passports from visa-exempt nationalities except the US, with more than six months' validity.

It requires a completed form and photographs, onward travel, the stated fee, blank pages, and no criminal record or local prohibition. It is a non-extendable 30-day stay that cannot normally convert, at only the stated airport ports.
A special-needs arrival visa for another nationality requires MOFA approval plus a central-government invitation or event, disaster relief, or another important cause; it is not nationality-wide.
TWAC, security, prior-history, purpose, residence, passport, and admission requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents: online entry and exit permit
policies.summary: Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents may apply online for an NIA entry and exit permit; this is a permit route, not a general foreign-visa or visa-exemption rule.
conditions: The ETA label represents an advance online permit workflow only. It is not established from the HK or MO passport code alone: the NIA requires the matching permanent resident ID and a passport valid for more than three months.
A person born in Mainland China must supply the stated non-registration, Home Return Permit, or household-registration-cancellation document. Other documents may be required.

Single, renewable, and multiple permits, their fees, and stays of no more than three months are distinct from a visa; overstay, off-purpose activity, and indicated criminal conduct may bar future applications.

This does not establish British National (Overseas), Portuguese-Macao, residence, employment, family, or other permit treatment. TWAC applies to holders of a multiple-entry permit unless NIA excepts them.

policies.title: Named nationalities: nationality-wide ordinary-passport eVisa route
policies.summary: BOCA names these nationalities for the eVisa route, subject to stated nationality, passport, purpose, review, and admission requirements; an issued eVisa is single-entry for up to 30 days.
conditions: This is limited to BOCA's named nationality list and ordinary passports. Invitation, event, designated-tour, and business-recommendation eVisa routes are purpose- or sponsor-conditioned, not nationality-wide access.

Colombia needs the stated Schengen or US document. Armenia, Kazakhstan, and Uzbekistan require the stated Schengen or US document from 2026-03-31 through 2027-03-31 unless using BOCA's specified Ecode route. Russian ordinary passports are eligible only 2026-07-07 through 2027-07-06. Türkiye is ordinary or special passports subject to rolling reciprocity; this policy is ordinary only.

The passport must have six months' validity at application. The mission may request more documents. The route is for tourism, business, relatives, conferences, or sport only; employment, study, family residence, and language study require a suitable overseas-mission visa.

It is valid three months from issue, single entry, maximum 30-day stay, non-extendable and non-convertible. Print the issued eVisa for NIA verification; the NIA may deny entry. Oman's 14-day exemption is separate.

application.label: BOCA eVisa application portal
steps: Confirm nationality-specific eligibility and all traveller-specific criteria.
Submit personal information and card payment online, and provide any requested additional documents.
Print the approved eVisa and present it for NIA verification on arrival.

policies.title: Other directly modelled ordinary foreign passports: visa required
policies.summary: These ordinary foreign-passport codes are neither on the current BOCA visa-exemption list nor the nationality-wide eVisa list, so a valid ROC visa is required under the Visa Statute.
conditions: The default applies only to a foreign passport or travel document recognized or accepted by ROC authorities. This ordinary visitor policy does not establish unrecognized, stateless, refugee, emergency, temporary, diplomatic, official/service, laissez-passer, residence, or other special-document treatment.

A short stay may use a visitor visa; validity, entry count, duration, and requirements depend on nationality, purpose, passport type, and expiry. A stay over six months is the separate resident-visa route.

Visitor purposes include transit, tourism, family visits, inspections, conferences, business, short study, short employment, missionary work, and an approved activity. Work or profit-making needs central-authority approval.

MOFA may assess residence-country relations, purpose, support, health, criminal and immigration history, false statements, document recognition or authenticity, terrorism, and national-security or public-order concerns. No non-nationality-wide eVisa route is classified as eVisa access here. TWAC applies unless NIA's resident-visa, ARC, or diplomatic-ID exemption applies.

conflicts.explanation: BOCA's current list includes Armenia subject to stated document or Ecode conditions; the fallback labels it visa_required.
Burkina Faso is absent from BOCA's nationality-wide eVisa list. Event, invitation, and group routes are not general ordinary-passport eVisa access; the statute's valid-visa default applies.
Haiti is absent from BOCA's current visa-exemption list but is on its current nationality-wide eVisa list.
BOCA's current list includes Kazakhstan subject to stated document or Ecode conditions; the fallback labels it visa_required.
Nicaragua is absent from both current BOCA nationality-wide exemption and eVisa lists, so the statute's valid-visa default applies.
BOCA currently permits Russian ordinary-passport eVisa applications from 2026-07-07 through 2027-07-06.
Solomon Islands is absent from BOCA's nationality-wide eVisa list; event, invitation, and group routes are conditional and the statute's default applies.
BOCA's current eVisa list includes ordinary Turkish passports; landing visas cover emergency or temporary passports from visa-exempt nationalities, not Turkish ordinary passports.
BOCA's current list includes Uzbekistan subject to stated document or Ecode conditions; the fallback labels it visa_required.

unresolved.reason: NIA identifies purpose-specific entry permits for people from Mainland China and BOCA excludes PRC passport holders from its foreign-visa online process. The reviewed English sources do not establish one current ordinary PRC-passport visitor rule for this schema.

The statute reaches only foreign passports or travel documents recognized or accepted by ROC authorities. The reviewed sources do not establish recognition or an ordinary Palestinian passport visitor rule, so territorial-document status is not inferred from the default.
